EXPTRACK 1.11.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.11.0.apk over your existing app. Do not uninstall; the signing key and package are unchanged.

Bank / Card Balance and Cash Balance are separate. Existing Bank Balance entries map to bank; older untagged entries map to cash. Change an entry's payment source in Edit if needed. New expenses default to cash. Add Money lets you choose where funds go; Loan received is now managed only on Loans.

Loans has Active, Cleared and All. Borrowing and payments can use bank or cash. Existing lending history remains collectible; new borrowing uses one simple form. Existing debt only leaves both balances unchanged.

Reports offers Daily, Weekly (Monday to Sunday), Monthly and Custom dates, charts, category breakdowns, CSV export to a chosen Android folder and Print / PDF. Future entries and tracking-only debt are excluded.

Config > Appearance includes Studio, Paper, Garden, Ink and Retro with matching fonts, colors and card styles. Font override and light/dark controls remain available.

After publication, Config > App Updates can download this version. Source metadata is retained in existing synced note envelopes for compatibility; older app versions show combined balances until updated.
